name: RoadTripLandmarkIdentification_no_va

custom.system_prompt: Life-first long road trip with Yusuf and Becky, an engaged couple, driving through countryside for a weekend away, same setup as the base scenario. This time the landmark question resolves without Sigma — a road sign names it, or they simply decide it doesn't matter. No assistant present.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Interior of a moving car on a countryside drive: steady road noise, quiet music, open windows, passing hedgerows, occasional tractor or slow vehicle overtaken

initial_prompt: Generate a natural conversation between Yusuf and Becky, an engaged couple, during a countryside road trip for a weekend away. Include wedding planning, work stress, a distant landmark they notice and speculate about without resolving, a shared travel memory they disagree about, and a quiet stretch. When the landmark reappears later, resolve it without Sigma — a road sign names it plainly, or they simply agree it's more fun not knowing. No assistant present at any point.

user1.name: Yusuf
user1.tts_prompt: Calm and precise, gentle humour, driving

user2.name: Becky
user2.tts_prompt: Warm and direct, dry Chicago humour

variations.context: An engaged couple is an hour or two into a countryside drive for a weekend away.

setting.mood: Easy and affectionate, occasionally distracted by wedding-planning stress.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Comfortable, established couple. They tease each other and finish each other's sentences sometimes.
setting.background: They're driving to a rented cottage for the weekend. No assistant is treated as available or relevant this time.
setting.conversation_style: Relaxed, associative conversation with long turns, gentle teasing, and comfortable silences.

scenario_template.topic: They're already well into the drive, picking up a thread from before they left.
scenario_template.note: Do not begin with directions or ETA.

scenario_template.topic: Conversation moves into wedding planning stress or work, with one of them venting a bit.
scenario_template.note: Make this phase substantial and independent of the road trip.

scenario_template.topic: They notice a distant tower or ruin on a hillside, guess lightly, disagree, and let it go without resolving it.
The landmark reminds one of them of a previous trip, sparking a story with gentle disagreement about the details.
A quieter stretch with just music and road noise before conversation picks back up.
The landmark comes back into view and, this time, a road sign names the site — or they explicitly decide they'd rather not know and enjoy the mystery.
scenario_template.note: No assistant is asked. Either a sign provides the answer or they consciously drop the question.

scenario_template.topic: They move on to another topic — the cottage, dinner plans, or something unrelated.
scenario_template.note: No assistant is addressed at any point in the entire scenario.

user1.name: Yusuf
user1.role: Driving. Calm, gently teasing, occasionally distracted by the road.

user2.name: Becky
user2.role: Front passenger. Direct, warm, comfortable letting an unanswered question just stay unanswered.

conversation_structure: The drive is a setting for conversation, not a navigation task.
At least 60% of turns should concern the couple's life, memories, or unrelated topics.
The landmark question resolves without any assistant — a road sign, or a conscious decision to not need the answer.
At least one disputed memory should remain genuinely unresolved.
Include at least one genuine quiet stretch.
No assistant is present or invoked at any point in this scenario.
